name: layout12
description: romantic floral aesthetic collage / dreamy Pinterest moodboard layout. Soft warm beige and cream color palette with golden-hour lighting, delicate feminine styling, and vintage-inspired editorial photography. Background features textured paper surfaces, subtle shadows from flowers and sunlight, creating a calm and ethereal atmosphere. The layout contains 4 distinct photo slots arranged in an overlapping collage composition. One large portrait photo occupies the upper section as the main image, one narrow horizontal close-up photo positioned in the center showing facial details, one vertical close-up eye portrait photo positioned on the lower left, and one vertical portrait photo positioned on the lower right. Decorative elements include realistic lily flowers layered around the composition, soft botanical accents, paper photo borders, and a floating music player card inspired by a mobile music application interface. The collage uses gentle overlapping layers with natural depth and soft shadows. Dreamy skin tones, floral fairy-core aesthetic, romantic visual storytelling, delicate beauty photography, and cozy vintage mood. Follow the exact number, shape, scale hierarchy, overlap style, and arrangement of photo slots shown in the layout reference.
swipe_cta: Add a small elegant music-card sticker, paper label, or botanical tag containing a short swipe-related CTA (such as 'Swipe →' or a similar concise variation). Keep the wording subtle and aesthetic. Integrate it naturally with the floral decorations, paper textures, and dreamy vintage mood while preserving the soft editorial composition.
